title: Who Broke Me? Execution-Guided Repair of Behavioral Dependency Breaks
title_zh: 是谁打破了我？基于执行的修复行为依赖中断的方法

paragraphs.en: Dependency upgrades can break downstream projects without changing the library interface. Such behavioral breaking changes are difficult for developers to fix, because the failing test does not always point to the root API , the upstream API that causes the break. Existing LLM-based repair methods obtain evidence for the repair from compiler feedback or library documentation. However, a behavioral break produces no compiler feedback and is often undocumented. Agents that receive no upgrade evidence also usually do not retrieve upstream evidence themselves, and most of their failed repairs do not identify the root API.
paragraphs.zh: 依赖项的升级可能会在没有改变库接口的情况下破坏下游项目。 这类行为破坏性变更对开发者来说难以修复，因为失败的测试并不总能指出根本的 API——即导致破坏的上游 API。 现有的基于 LLM 的修复方法从编译器反馈或库文档中获取修复依据。 然而，行为破坏不会产生任何编译器反馈，而且通常没有相关文档记录。 未收到升级证据的智能体通常也不会自行检索上游证据，并且它们大多数失败的修复都无法识别出根本的 API。

paragraphs.en: The library diff provides useful upstream evidence, but the root API must first be identified to select the relevant part of the diff. We present BBCFixer, a repair method that runs the failing test under the old and new library versions, ranks the calls whose return value differs to identify a candidate root API, and filters the library diff with that candidate. To evaluate repairs of behavioral breaks, we further introduce BBCBench, a benchmark of 100 behavioral dependency breaks in Python and JavaScript.
paragraphs.zh: 库差异提供了有用的上游证据，但必须首先确定根 API，以便选择差异中的相关部分。 我们提出了 BBCFixer，这是一种修复方法：它在旧版和新版库下运行失败的测试，对返回值不同的调用进行排序以确定候选根 API，然后用该候选项过滤库差异。 为了评估行为中断的修复效果，我们进一步引入了 BBCBench，这是一个包含 100 个 Python 和 JavaScript 行为依赖中断的基准测试集。

sents.en: We present BBCFixer, a repair method that runs the failing test under the old and new library versions, ranks the calls whose return value differs to identify a candidate root API, and filters the library diff with that candidate.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 BBCFixer，这是一种修复方法：它在旧版和新版库下运行失败的测试，对返回值不同的调用进行排序以确定候选根 API，然后用该候选项过滤库差异。

sents.en: To evaluate repairs of behavioral breaks, we further introduce BBCBench, a benchmark of 100 behavioral dependency breaks in Python and JavaScript.
sents.zh: 为了评估行为中断的修复效果，我们进一步引入了 BBCBench，这是一个包含 100 个 Python 和 JavaScript 行为依赖中断的基准测试集。

paragraphs.en: We compare BBCFixer on BBCBench with two baselines: (1) Pure Agent, an agent that receives no upgrade evidence, and (2) BDUpdater, a method that mines library documentation. BBCFixer raises the average pass rate by up to 17% relative to Pure Agent and needs up to 27% fewer agent steps per successful repair. BBCFixer thus provides a way to select the upstream evidence behind a behavioral break, so that an LLM agent can repair behavioral breaking changes more effectively and efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 BBCBench 上对 BBCFixer 与两种基线方法进行了比较：(1) Pure Agent，一种未接收任何升级证据的智能体；以及 (2) BDUpdater，一种通过挖掘库文档进行修复的方法。 与 Pure Agent 相比，BBCFixer 将平均通过率提升了最多 17%，并且每次成功修复所需的智能体步骤减少了最多 27%。 因此，BBCFixer 提供了一种选择行为中断背后上游证据的方法，使 LLM 智能体能够更有效、更高效地修复导致行为中断的变更。

paragraphs.en: Modern software depends heavily on third-party libraries, whose upgrades deliver security fixes, bug fixes, and new functionality. Yet developers often postpone these upgrades: 81.5% of the systems studied by Kula et al. ( Kula et al., 2018 ) retain outdated dependencies. One reason is that a new library version can introduce breaking changes that cause existing downstream code to fail ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Bavota et al., 2015 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现代软件严重依赖第三方库，而这些库的升级会带来安全修复、错误修正和新功能。 然而，开发人员常常推迟这些升级：Kula 等人研究的系统中，有 81.5% 的系统 （Kula 等人，2018）仍保留着过时的依赖项。 其中一个原因是，新的库版本可能会引入破坏性变更，导致现有的下游代码失效（Chen 等人，2026；Bavota 等人，2015）。

sents.en: Modern software depends heavily on third-party libraries, whose upgrades deliver security fixes, bug fixes, and new functionality.

sents.en: ( Kula et al., 2018 ) retain outdated dependencies.
sents.zh: （Kula 等人，2018）仍保留着过时的依赖项。

sents.en: One reason is that a new library version can introduce breaking changes that cause existing downstream code to fail ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Bavota et al., 2015 ) .
sents.zh: 其中一个原因是，新的库版本可能会引入破坏性变更，导致现有的下游代码失效（Chen 等人，2026；Bavota 等人，2015）。

paragraphs.en: Breaking changes are commonly categorized as syntactic or behavioral ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Jayasuriya et al., 2024 ) . A syntactic breaking change alters the library interface, for example by removing an API or changing its signature. Such changes produce compiler or import errors that identify the affected symbol and direct developers toward the upgrade ( Mostafa et al., 2017 ) . A behavioral breaking change is more implicit and harder to diagnose: the interface remains intact, but the run-time behavior changes . The downstream project still builds, but the break instead appears as a failing test whose error may not point to the library or API that causes the break. Such breaks are difficult for developers to fix in practice. In the real-world bug reports studied by Mostafa et al., 18% of the client bugs caused by behavioral backward incompatibilities remain unfixed, although most developers try to fix them ( Mostafa et al., 2017 ) . Therefore, this paper focuses on the repair of these behavioral dependency breaks.
paragraphs.zh: 破坏性变更通常被归类为语法性变更或行为性变更（Chen 等人，2026；Jayasuriya 等人，2024）。 语法性破坏性变更会改变库的接口，例如通过移除某个 API 或修改其签名。 此类变更会产生编译器或导入错误，从而识别出受影响的符号，并引导开发者进行升级（Mostafa 等人，2017）。 行为性破坏性变更则更为隐晦且更难诊断：接口本身保持完整，但运行时行为发生了变化。 下游项目仍然能够构建，但这种破坏性变更反而表现为测试失败，而错误信息可能并未指向导致问题的库或 API。 实际上，这类问题对开发者来说很难修复。 在 Mostafa 等人研究的真实世界错误报告中，由行为向后不兼容性引起的客户端错误中有 18% 仍未修复，尽管大多数开发者都尝试过修复它们（Mostafa 等人，2017）。 因此，本文重点关注修复这些行为依赖破坏性变更的问题。

paragraphs.en: Recent work repairs breaking changes either with single-call LLM pipelines ( Reyes et al., 2026b ; Mecheo et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) or with LLM agents ( Fruntke and Krinke, 2025 ; Reyes et al., 2026a ; Tawosi et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) . Both pipelines and agents need evidence that connects the downstream failure to the upstream change, and obtain it from compiler feedback or library documentation. For example, Byam prompts the LLM with the compilation errors of the broken build ( Reyes et al., 2026b ) , and BDUpdater mines breaking change records from the upstream repository ( Xia et al., 2026 ) . Neither source works for a behavioral break. Compiler feedback is absent in behavioral breaks, and documentation is unreliable: Mostafa et al. find that only 27.7% of the behavioral backward incompatibilities they detect are documented ( Mostafa et al., 2017 ) .

paragraphs.en: Challenge 1 : in repairing breaking changes with LLM agents, cost matters in practice . One library update breaks many downstream projects, and each must be repaired separately ( Reyes et al., 2026a ) . At this scale, the cost of each agent run dominates the total cost ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ) , so low-priced models are the practical choice. Higher-priced models also do not consistently give better cost-efficiency in LLM-based program repair ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . Mining documentation adds to this cost. In our experiments (Section 4.2 ), BDUpdater raises the cost of each successful repair by up to 132%. The search for documentation consumes the agent steps that the repair itself needs. As a result, recent work either lacks the evidence that a behavioral break requires, or searches for it at a high cost.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战 1：在使用 LLM 智能体修复破坏性变更时，成本在实际应用中至关重要。 一次库更新会破坏许多下游项目，而每个项目都必须单独修复（Reyes 等，2026a）。 在这一规模下，每次智能体运行的成本占总成本的主导地位（Kapoor 等，2024），因此低价模型是实际可行的选择。 价格更高的模型在基于 LLM 的程序修复中，也并未始终表现出更好的成本效益（Liu 等，2026a）。 挖掘文档还会增加这一成本。 在我们的实验中（第 4.2 节），BDUpdater 使每次成功修复的成本最多增加了 132%。 搜索文档会消耗智能体本身修复所需的步骤。 因此，近期的研究要么缺乏行为破坏所需的证据，要么以高昂的成本去搜寻这些证据。

paragraphs.en: Challenge 2 is not merely generating a patch, but selecting the evidence that makes the required adaptation apparent . This evidence must be condensed before the agent begins, rather than mined by the agent during the run. The failure is observed in a downstream test, whereas its explanation resides in the upstream version history. We call this separation the evidence-selection gap . In our Pure Agent setting (Section 3.3 ), the agent receives no upgrade evidence but can inspect the repository and the installed library. However, most agent runs consult neither textual nor code-level information about the upgraded library, and failure to identify the relevant upstream behavioral change is the dominant failure pattern (Section 4.1 ).

paragraphs.en: The library diff provides a direct source of upstream evidence but requires selection, because the full diff is far too large for an agent to read (Section 2.2 ). The diff covers changes to many library APIs, and a failing downstream test often reaches several of them. However, the break is caused by the behavior change of one of them, the root API . The root API is hard to identify, because the failing test makes many calls into the library and the error message often does not name the API. Our key insight is therefore to use differential execution as a selector for upstream evidence . Differential execution runs the same failing test under the old and new library versions and reveals the library calls whose return value differs. Prior work uses differential execution to detect incompatibilities ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ; Monce et al., 2025 ; Pradel, 2026 ) , whereas we use it to select evidence for repair. We propose BBCFixer, which ranks these diverging calls, takes the highest-ranked one as the first divergence , and uses its API as a candidate root API . BBCFixer then filters the library diff with that candidate and gives the repair agent the first divergence and the filtered library diff as evidence. BBCFixer turns a large upstream version change into compact, downstream-specific repair evidence before the agent begins its search. In this way, the agent can spend its steps on the repair itself and keep its context small. BBCFixer therefore lowers the cost of each successful repair compared with mining documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 库差异提供了直接的上游证据来源，但需要进行筛选，因为完整的差异内容对于智能体而言过于庞大，无法完整阅读（第 2.2 节）。 该差异涵盖了库中许多 API 的变更，而一个失败的下游测试通常会涉及其中多个 API。 然而，故障是由其中一个 API——根 API——的行为变化引起的。 根 API 很难确定，因为失败的测试会多次调用库中的多个 API，且错误信息通常不会指出具体的 API。 因此，我们的关键思路是将差异执行用作上游证据的选择器。 差异执行会在旧版和新版库环境下运行相同的失败测试，从而揭示返回值发生变化的库调用。 先前的研究利用差异执行来检测不兼容性（Wang et al., 2022；Zhu et al., 2023；Monce et al., 2025；Pradel, 2026），而我们则用它来选择修复所需的证据。 我们提出了 BBCFixer，它能对这些存在差异的调用进行排序，将排名最高的调用作为首个差异点，并将其 API 视为候选根 API。 随后，BBCFixer 会用该候选 API 对库差异进行过滤，并将首个差异点和过滤后的库差异作为证据提供给修复智能体。 BBCFixer 在智能体开始搜索之前，就将大规模的上游版本变更转化为紧凑且针对下游的修复证据。 通过这种方式，智能体可以将步骤用于修复本身，同时保持上下文信息简洁。 因此，与挖掘文档相比，BBCFixer 降低了每次成功修复的成本。

sents.en: The library diff provides a direct source of upstream evidence but requires selection, because the full diff is far too large for an agent to read (Section 2.2 ).
sents.zh: 库差异提供了直接的上游证据来源，但需要进行筛选，因为完整的差异内容对于智能体而言过于庞大，无法完整阅读（第 2.2 节）。

sents.en: The diff covers changes to many library APIs, and a failing downstream test often reaches several of them.
sents.zh: 该差异涵盖了库中许多 API 的变更，而一个失败的下游测试通常会涉及其中多个 API。

sents.en: However, the break is caused by the behavior change of one of them, the root API .
sents.zh: 然而，故障是由其中一个 API——根 API——的行为变化引起的。

sents.en: The root API is hard to identify, because the failing test makes many calls into the library and the error message often does not name the API.
sents.zh: 根 API 很难确定，因为失败的测试会多次调用库中的多个 API，且错误信息通常不会指出具体的 API。

sents.en: Our key insight is therefore to use differential execution as a selector for upstream evidence .
sents.zh: 因此，我们的关键思路是将差异执行用作上游证据的选择器。

sents.en: Differential execution runs the same failing test under the old and new library versions and reveals the library calls whose return value differs.
sents.zh: 差异执行会在旧版和新版库环境下运行相同的失败测试，从而揭示返回值发生变化的库调用。

sents.en: Prior work uses differential execution to detect incompatibilities ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ; Monce et al., 2025 ; Pradel, 2026 ) , whereas we use it to select evidence for repair.
sents.zh: 先前的研究利用差异执行来检测不兼容性（Wang et al., 2022；Zhu et al., 2023；Monce et al., 2025；Pradel, 2026），而我们则用它来选择修复所需的证据。

sents.en: We propose BBCFixer, which ranks these diverging calls, takes the highest-ranked one as the first divergence , and uses its API as a candidate root API .
sents.zh: 我们提出了 BBCFixer，它能对这些存在差异的调用进行排序，将排名最高的调用作为首个差异点，并将其 API 视为候选根 API。

sents.en: BBCFixer then filters the library diff with that candidate and gives the repair agent the first divergence and the filtered library diff as evidence.
sents.zh: 随后，BBCFixer 会用该候选 API 对库差异进行过滤，并将首个差异点和过滤后的库差异作为证据提供给修复智能体。

sents.en: BBCFixer turns a large upstream version change into compact, downstream-specific repair evidence before the agent begins its search.
sents.zh: BBCFixer 在智能体开始搜索之前，就将大规模的上游版本变更转化为紧凑且针对下游的修复证据。

sents.en: In this way, the agent can spend its steps on the repair itself and keep its context small.
sents.zh: 通过这种方式，智能体可以将步骤用于修复本身，同时保持上下文信息简洁。

sents.en: BBCFixer therefore lowers the cost of each successful repair compared with mining documentation.
sents.zh: 因此，与挖掘文档相比，BBCFixer 降低了每次成功修复的成本。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, evaluating repairs of behavioral breaks also requires a suitable benchmark. Existing dependency-upgrade benchmarks contain few confirmed behavioral breaks (Section 3.2.1 ), and most of them also lack either reference fixes or a public harness that reproduces each case. A reference fix serves as the oracle: its test changes encode the correct new behavior, so they can check an agent’s repair. We therefore construct BBCBench to address these problems. BBCBench contains 100 behavioral dependency breaks in real Python and JavaScript projects, each with a reference fix and a reproducible harness for the repair task.

paragraphs.en: We then compare BBCFixer with two baselines (i.e., Pure Agent and BDUpdater) (Section 3.3 ) on BBCBench, using two budget models, qwen3-coder and GLM-4.5-Air, over three rounds. We run three rounds because the outcome of a single run varies between repetitions. BBCFixer raises the pass rate above both settings under both models in every round. BBCFixer raises the average pass rate by up to 17 % over Pure Agent and by up to 53 % over BDUpdater. BBCFixer also needs fewer agent steps per successful repair: up to 27 % fewer than Pure Agent and up to 58 % fewer than BDUpdater.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，我们在 BBCBench 上，使用 qwen3-coder 和 GLM-4.5-Air 两种预算模型，通过三轮测试，将 BBCFixer 与两个基线方法（即 Pure Agent 和 BDUpdater）进行了比较（第 3.3 节）。 我们运行三轮测试，因为单次运行的结果在不同重复实验中会有所差异。 在每一轮测试中，BBCFixer 在这两种模型下的通过率都高于另外两种方法。 BBCFixer 的平均通过率相比 Pure Agent 最高提升了 17%，相比 BDUpdater 最高提升了 53%。 BBCFixer 每次成功修复所需的智能体步数也更少：比 Pure Agent 最多减少 27%，比 BDUpdater 最多减少 58%。

paragraphs.en: In summary, this paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: Problem formulation and empirical finding . We characterize the repair of behavioral breaking changes as an evidence-selection problem. Our trajectory analysis shows that repository access alone does not lead the agent to retrieve the necessary upstream evidence and most failing runs never identify the root API.
paragraphs.zh: 问题构建与实证发现。 我们将行为破坏性变更的修复描述为一个证据选择问题。 我们的轨迹分析表明，仅通过访问代码库并不会引导智能体检索必要的上游证据，且大多数失败的运行从未识别出根本的 API。

sents.zh: 问题构建与实证发现。

sents.en: We characterize the repair of behavioral breaking changes as an evidence-selection problem.
sents.zh: 我们将行为破坏性变更的修复描述为一个证据选择问题。

paragraphs.en: Approach . We propose BBCFixer, a repair method that uses differential execution to rank the calls whose return value differs, identify a candidate root API, and filter the library diff with that candidate. The first divergence and the filtered library diff then serve as repair evidence for the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 我们提出了 BBCFixer，这是一种修复方法，它利用差异执行来对返回值不同的调用进行排序，识别候选根 API，并基于该候选 API 过滤库的差异。 随后，首次分歧和经过过滤的库差异将作为智能体的修复依据。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark . We construct BBCBench, a benchmark of 100 confirmed behavioral dependency breaks in real Python and JavaScript projects. Each case includes a reproducible harness and a reference fix whose test changes encode the intended post-upgrade behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们构建了 BBCBench，这是一个基准测试，包含在真实 Python 和 JavaScript 项目中确认的 100 个行为依赖中断案例。 每个案例都包含一个可复现的测试框架和一个参考修复方案，其测试变更编码了升级后的预期行为。

sents.zh: 基准测试。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation and implications . We evaluate BBCFixer on BBCBench against Pure Agent and BDUpdater. BBCFixer achieves a higher average pass rate under both models, with fewer agent steps and lower cost per successful repair. The gain of BBCFixer depends on how the evidence is built and concentrates on the cases whose evidence points to the labeled root API. The evaluation indicates that building failure-specific evidence is a useful complement to improving the agent itself.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we discuss the background and the motivation of this study. Section 2.1 defines behavioral breaking changes and the repair task. Section 2.2 shows that the library diff of the upgrade carries the evidence but is too large to use without filtering.

paragraphs.en: A behavioral breaking change leaves the interface intact but alters the library behavior, such as the type of a return value or a default setting. Figure 1 shows an example, in which the downstream project hubot-coffeepoll, a chat-bot plugin for coffee-shop polls, upgrades lodash from 3.10.1 to 4.17.21. In 3.10.1, _.sample() called with a count of 3 returns an array of three random elements. In 4.17.21, _.sample() ignores the count and returns a single element, and the new function _.sampleSize() returns the three elements instead. The downstream call still runs, since JavaScript does not check the number of arguments. The plugin, however, now receives one object instead of an array, stores an empty list of candidate venues, and fails six tests. The case shows two properties of behavioral breaking changes. First, the change is hidden, since the failing assertions and their stack traces name only the test file, not lodash. Second, the repair needs information that the failure does not carry: the developer must find that _.sample() no longer returns an array and that _.sampleSize() now does, before rewriting the call.

paragraphs.en: The repair task for the agent is defined as follows. The agent receives a downstream repository that breaks after one dependency is upgraded to a target version v_new . The agent modifies the downstream source code so that the repository builds and passes its tests on v_new . Downgrading the dependency, removing it, or switching to another version is not allowed. Section 3.3 lists the full constraints and budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的修复任务定义如下。 智能体接收一个下游仓库，该仓库在某个依赖项升级到目标版本 v_new 后会出现问题。 智能体需要修改下游源代码，使该仓库在 v_new 上能够构建并通过测试。 不允许降级该依赖项、移除它或切换到其他版本。 第 3.3 节列出了完整的约束条件和预算限制。

sents.en: The repair task for the agent is defined as follows.

sents.en: The agent receives a downstream repository that breaks after one dependency is upgraded to a target version v_new .

sents.en: The agent modifies the downstream source code so that the repository builds and passes its tests on v_new .
sents.zh: 智能体需要修改下游源代码，使该仓库在 v_new 上能够构建并通过测试。

paragraphs.en: The library diff, however, is far too large for an agent to read. Across the 100 benchmark cases (Section 3.2 ), the diff between the two library versions has a median of 115,866 lines, spread over a median of 168 files. Feeding the whole diff to the agent buries the few relevant lines, so the diff must be filtered down to the fragment that explains the break. Effective filtering keeps the root API, and identifying that API is difficult. One failing test touches several upstream APIs, the interface stays unchanged, and the error message names none of them. Figure 2 shows how the candidates narrow on an illustrative failing test. Across the benchmark cases, one failing test touches a median of 5 distinct upstream APIs, of which the library diff changes a median of 3. Keeping only the changed APIs therefore still leaves several candidates, and selecting among them needs evidence that depends on how the downstream actually uses the library. In the figure, only lib.load() returns a different value under the two versions, and this difference singles it out as the root API.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，库的差异文件对于智能体而言过于庞大，无法直接阅读。 在 100 个基准测试用例（第 3.2 节）中，两个库版本之间的差异文件中位数包含 115,866 行代码，分布在 168 个文件中。 将整个差异文件输入智能体，会导致少数相关行被淹没，因此必须将差异文件过滤为能够解释故障的片段。 有效的过滤需要保留根 API，但确定该 API 本身十分困难。 一个失败的测试用例涉及多个上游 API，但其接口保持不变，且错误信息中未提及其中任何一个。 图 2 展示了在一个示例性的失败测试用例中，候选 API 是如何逐步缩小的。 在所有基准测试用例中，每个失败的测试用例平均涉及 5 个不同的上游 API，而库的差异文件影响了其中中位数为 3 个。 因此，仅保留发生变化的 API 后仍会剩下多个候选项，要从中选出正确项，需要依据下游实际使用库的方式提供的证据。 在图中，只有 lib.load() 在两个版本中的返回值不同，这一差异使其成为根 API。

paragraphs.en: Our research design connects three components. First, BBCFixer transforms the behavioral difference observed in a downstream test into compact upstream repair evidence (Section 3.1 ). Second, BBCBench provides 100 behavioral dependency breaks in real downstream projects, each with reproducible intact, broken, and fixed states and an automated evaluation script (Section 3.2 ). Third, the experimental setup evaluates the complete repair workflow and its evidence configurations under two models (Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究设计将三个组成部分连接起来。 首先，BBCFixer 将下游测试中观察到的行为差异转化为紧凑的上游修复证据（第 3.1 节）。 其次，BBCBench 提供了真实下游项目中的 100 个行为依赖中断，每个中断都包含可复现的完整、损坏和修复状态，以及一个自动化评估脚本（第 3.2 节）。 第三，实验设置评估了完整的修复工作流程及其证据配置在两种模型下的表现（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: BBCFixer addresses the evidence-selection gap identified in Section 1 . Its goal is not to ask the repair agent to inspect the entire upstream version history, but to construct a compact explanation of the observed downstream failure before repair begins. As Figure 3 shows, the pipeline has three stages. It first compares the failing test under the intact and broken dependency versions to prioritize a candidate upstream API (Section 3.1.1 ). It then uses this candidate and the failure symptoms to extract relevant fragments from the library diff (Section 3.1.2 ). Finally, it presents the first divergence and the filtered library diff to the repair agent as failure-specific evidence (Section 3.1.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: BBCFixer 解决了第 1 节中指出的证据选择问题。 其目标并非要求修复智能体检查整个上游版本历史，而是在修复开始前构建一个对已观察到的下游故障的简洁解释。 如图 3 所示，该流程包含三个阶段。 它首先比较在完整和损坏依赖版本下失败的测试，以优先确定一个候选上游 API（第 3.1.1 节）。 接着，它利用该候选项和故障症状从库差异中提取相关片段（第 3.1.2 节）。 最后，它将首次分歧和筛选后的库差异作为与故障相关的特定证据呈现给修复智能体（第 3.1.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Panel a of Figure 3 shows this step. BBCFixer runs the failing test twice, once in the intact state with the old library version and once in the broken state with the upgraded version. During each run, BBCFixer records every call that enters the upgraded library from outside it, with its arguments and its return value. It then aligns the recorded calls across the two executions and compares their observed return values. A call is a divergence when its return value differs between the old and new library versions. Multiple calls may diverge during one test execution, so BBCFixer ranks these divergences to select the one most likely to be relevant to the downstream failure. Calls originating in downstream code rank above calls originating in other libraries. Among downstream calls, those from files appearing in the failing stack trace rank higher; remaining ties are resolved by execution order. We call the highest-ranked divergence the first divergence and use its API as a candidate root API.
paragraphs.zh: 图3的a部分展示了此步骤。 BBCFixer会两次运行失败的测试：一次在旧库版本完好状态下运行，另一次在新库版本升级后的故障状态下运行。 每次运行时，BBCFixer都会记录所有从外部进入升级后库的调用，包括其参数和返回值。 然后，它会将两次执行中记录的调用进行对齐，并比较它们观察到的返回值。 当某个调用的返回值在旧版和新版库中存在差异时，该调用即被视为分歧点。 在一次测试执行中可能有多处调用出现分歧，因此BBCFixer会对这些分歧点进行排序，以选出最可能与下游故障相关的那个。 源自下游代码的调用会排在源自其他库的调用之前。 在下游调用中，来自失败堆栈跟踪中所列文件中的调用排名更高；其余排名相同的情况则按执行顺序决定。 我们将排名最高的分歧点称为“第一分歧点”，并使用其API作为候选根API。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 also carries a running example. The failing test first calls parse_cfg , which returns the same value in both executions. The two later calls, format_date and render , both diverge. The call to format_date returns ’2026-08-11’ with the old library version and ’11/08/2026’ with the new version, and render then returns a different value because it receives this changed date string as input. Both diverging calls originate in the same downstream file, so the ranking resolves by execution order and BBCFixer selects the earlier divergence, format_date , as the candidate root API.

paragraphs.en: Evaluating a repair method for behavioral breaks requires more than a downstream project that fails after an upgrade. Because the upstream behavioral change may be intentional, tests that encode the old behavior can reject an otherwise correct adaptation. BBCBench is designed around this oracle problem, and every case provides a confirmed behavioral break, a reproducible three-state harness, and a reference fix whose test changes encode the intended post-upgrade behavior. We first explain why existing benchmarks do not meet these requirements (Section 3.2.1 ), then describe how BBCBench is constructed and what it contains (Section 3.2.2 ), and finally explain how an agent works on BBCBench and how its repair is evaluated (Section 3.2.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 评估行为中断的修复方法，需要的不仅仅是某个在升级后失效的下游项目。 由于上游的行为变化可能是有意为之，因此编码旧行为的测试可能会拒绝一个原本正确的适应性调整。 BBCBench 正是围绕这一“神谕问题”设计的：每个用例都包含一个已确认的行为中断、一个可复现的三状态测试框架，以及一个参考修复方案，其测试变更编码了升级后的预期行为。 我们首先解释为何现有基准测试无法满足这些要求（第 3.2.1 节），接着描述 BBCBench 的构建方式及其内容（第 3.2.2 节），最后说明智能体如何在 BBCBench 上运行，以及其修复效果如何评估（第 3.2.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: The repair task defined in Section 2.1 places three requirements on a benchmark. First , a case must contain a confirmed behavioral break in a real downstream project. Second , the case must provide a reference fix whose test changes encode the intended post-upgrade behavior, because an intentional behavioral change may invalidate tests that encode the old library behavior. Third , the case must include a public harness that replays the intact, broken, and repaired states consistently. Table 1 compares six existing dependency-upgrade benchmarks on these requirements. None of them focuses on behavioral breaking changes, and only TimeMachine-bench Verified has a confirmed behavioral subset, in which our audit finds 19 cases. In addition, BUMP and CompSuite provide no reference fixes, BDUpdater provides them for a minority of its cases, and DepBench and RepoRescue release no public harness. As of August 2026, no existing benchmark therefore meets all three requirements, so we construct BBCBench, whose size matches the three benchmarks that provide a reference fix for every case.

sents.en: Figure 4 summarizes how BBCBench is built.
sents.zh: 图 4 总结了 BBCBench 的构建方式。

sents.en: We collect real-world cases and their reference fixes from three sources, and we audit, package, and review every case.
sents.zh: 我们从三个来源收集真实案例及其参考修复方案，并对每个案例进行审核、打包和审查。

sents.en: We follow two steps below.
sents.zh: 我们将遵循以下两个步骤。

paragraphs.en: Every candidate is a real downstream project on GitHub that a behavioral breaking change in a third-party dependency breaks. We collect candidates from three sources, and each source also provides the reference fix of its candidates in its own way. First, benchmark authors produce and verify fixes for their own cases. We read the golden patch of each of the 100 TimeMachine-bench Verified cases, and the golden patch serves as the reference fix of the case. Second, downstream maintainers write fixes when they adapt their projects to a new library version. We search GitHub for commits, pull requests, and issues of this kind, with queries such as compatibility with numpy 2 , adapt to pandas 2.0 , and fix for <library> <version> . We take the parent of such an adaptation commit as the project before the fix, and the edits of the commit to production code and tests form the reference fix. Third, library documentation records the standard fix for a behavioral change in the migration guide, changelog, or release notes. For each such change, we use GitHub code search and the dependents list of the npm registry to find downstream projects that call the changed API. We check out a commit at which the project still pins the old library version, upgrade only that library, and confirm that the test suite fails. We then apply the documented fix at the actual call sites as the reference fix.
paragraphs.zh: 每个候选方案都是 GitHub 上的一个真实下游项目，其因第三方依赖项的行为破坏性变更而出现故障。 我们从三个来源收集候选方案，且每个来源都以自身方式提供其候选方案的参考修复方法。 首先，基准测试的作者会针对自己的用例生成并验证修复方案。 我们读取 TimeMachine-bench 中 100 个已验证用例的每个用例的黄金补丁，该黄金补丁即作为该用例的参考修复方案。 其次，下游项目的维护者在将项目适配到新的库版本时，会编写修复方案。 我们通过 GitHub 搜索此类提交、拉取请求和议题，查询条件包括“与 numpy 2 兼容”“适配 pandas 2.0”以及“<library> <version> 的修复”。 我们将此类适配提交的父提交视为修复前的项目，而该提交对生产代码和测试的修改则构成参考修复方案。 第三，库的文档会在迁移指南、变更日志或发布说明中记录行为变更的标准修复方法。 对于每个此类变更，我们使用 GitHub 代码搜索和 npm 注册表的依赖项列表，查找调用已变更 API 的下游项目。 我们会检出项目仍固定使用旧库版本的某个提交，仅升级该库，并确认测试套件会失败。 随后，我们将文档中记录的修复方案应用于实际的调用位置，作为参考修复方案。

paragraphs.en: None of these sources tells whether a candidate is behavioral, so we decide admission manually for every candidate from two observations. First, we read how the reference fix repairs the break. A fix that restores the old behavior or adapts the code to the new semantics indicates a behavioral breaking change, for example setting a default value explicitly. A fix that only renames an API, moves an import, or replaces a removed symbol indicates a syntactic breaking change, and we drop such candidates. Second, we run the tests after the upgrade. At least one test must fail on a wrong value or a runtime error that the changed behavior causes, not on a missing API. If the upgrade also removes or renames APIs, we first fix only those APIs and rerun the tests.

paragraphs.en: Every candidate then passes one shared audit with two criteria. First, the reference fix modifies production code, not only tests. Second, the error message must not point to the place that must be edited. We drop a case when the error trace points to a downstream line that the reference fix edits and one mechanical edit there repairs the break. Every admitted case is packaged as a reproducible harness that replays three states. In the intact state, the project passes its tests with the old dependency version. In the broken state, only the dependency is upgraded and at least part of the test suite fails. In the fixed state, the reference fix is applied and the tests pass. The reference fix includes the test edits that encode the intended post-upgrade behavior. A container image fixes the runtime, and a prebuilt image or a saved lockfile fixes the package versions of each state. Automated gates then scan logs and code comments for text that leaks the fix, reject reference fixes that touch no production file, and flag test runs in which no test executes. Two reviewers who did not build the case also re-run the gates and the three states, and each independently judges whether the case is behavioral and meets the two criteria. The two reviewers initially agree on 94% of the cases (Cohen’s kappa 0.81) and resolve the remaining disagreements by discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 每位候选人随后都会通过一次包含两个标准的共享审核。 首先，参考修复会修改生产代码，而不仅仅是测试代码。 其次，错误信息不得指向必须编辑的位置。 当错误追踪指向下游某行（该行为参考修复所修改的行），且对该行进行一次机械性编辑即可修复中断时，我们会放弃该案例。 每个被接受的案例都会被打包成一个可复现的测试框架，用于重演三种状态。 在完整状态下，项目使用旧版依赖项通过所有测试。 在故障状态下，仅升级依赖项，此时至少有一部分测试套件会失败。 在修复状态下，应用参考修复后，所有测试都会通过。 参考修复包含了用于编码预期升级后行为的测试修改。 容器镜像可修复运行时环境，而预构建镜像或已保存的锁文件则可固定每种状态下的包版本。 自动化关卡随后会扫描日志和代码注释，查找泄露修复信息的文本；拒绝任何未触及生产文件的参考修复；并标记没有测试执行的测试运行。 两位未参与构建该案例的评审员也会重新运行这些关卡和三种状态，并各自独立判断该案例是否符合行为要求且满足两个标准。 这两位评审员最初在 94% 的案例上达成一致（科恩卡帕值为 0.81），并通过讨论解决了其余的分歧。

paragraphs.en: BBCBench provides a workspace for the agent to work in and an automated evaluation script that judges the result. The workspace is the broken state of a case: the downstream project before the fix, with the target dependency upgraded to v_new , where at least one test fails on a wrong value or a runtime error that the changed behavior causes. In this workspace, the agent can read, run, and edit the project and its tests, and it can inspect the installed library. The evaluation script then decides whether the repair passes. At the end of a run, the script retains the agent’s production-code changes but discards all changes to test files, preventing a run from passing by weakening or removing tests. The script then applies only the test changes from the reference fix. These tests encode the intended post-upgrade behavior, while the reference production-code changes remain hidden and unapplied, allowing the agent to produce an alternative valid repair. All tests execute in the broken state, with the dependency pinned to v_new ; a separate version check rejects any run that downgrades, removes, or replaces the target dependency. A run passes only if the version check succeeds, the project builds, and the complete post-upgrade test suite passes within the judging budget.
paragraphs.zh: BBCBench 为智能体提供了一个工作空间，并附带一个用于评估结果的自动化评估脚本。 该工作空间是一个案例的“故障状态”：即修复前的下游项目，其中目标依赖项已升级至 v_new，且至少有一个测试因行为变化而失败（例如返回错误值或运行时错误）。 在此工作空间中，智能体可以读取、运行和编辑项目及其测试用例，还可以检查已安装的库。 随后，评估脚本会判断此次修复是否通过。 每次运行结束后，脚本会保留智能体对生产代码的修改，但会丢弃所有对测试文件的更改，从而防止因弱化或删除测试而导致运行通过。 接着，脚本仅应用参考修复中的测试更改。 这些测试编码了升级后的预期行为，而参考的生产代码更改则保持隐藏且未应用，这使得智能体能够提出另一种有效的修复方案。 所有测试均在故障状态下执行，且依赖项被锁定在 v_new；独立的版本检查会拒绝任何降级、移除或替换目标依赖项的运行。 只有当版本检查通过、项目成功构建，并且完整的升级后测试套件在评估预算内全部通过时，此次运行才算通过。

paragraphs.en: Every experiment uses the same agent, mini-swe-agent 2.4.6 ( The SWE-agent team, 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , a minimal agent framework whose only tool is the shell. The agent drives two open models, qwen3-coder ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) and GLM-4.5-Air ( GLM-4.5 Team, 2025 ) , through the OpenRouter API. Both models run at the default sampling temperature of 0.7 and keep the default values of all other sampling parameters. Each model call returns at most 4,096 tokens. All runs execute on one Linux virtual machine with 16 virtual CPUs and 62 GB of memory, and every run works in its own Docker container that holds the downstream project with the upgraded library. The agent may not consult online resources about the downstream project itself, because the real fix of every case is public. Each shell command times out after 10 minutes. Every setting uses the same two models and the same budget: each run stops at 100 steps, 30 minutes, or US$4, whichever the run reaches first, and cost is taken from the actual billing.
paragraphs.zh: 所有实验均使用相同的智能体——mini-swe-agent 2.4.6（The SWE-agent team，2025；Yang et al.，2024），这是一个最小化的智能体框架，其唯一工具是 shell。 该智能体通过 OpenRouter API 驱动两个开源模型：qwen3-coder（Qwen Team，2025）和 GLM-4.5-Air（GLM-4.5 Team，2025）。 这两个模型均以默认的采样温度 0.7 运行，并保持所有其他采样参数的默认值。 每次模型调用最多返回 4,096 个 token。 所有运行均在一台配备 16 个虚拟 CPU 和 62 GB 内存的 Linux 虚拟机上执行，且每次运行都在独立的 Docker 容器中完成，该容器包含已升级库的下游项目。 该智能体不得查询有关下游项目本身的在线资源，因为每个案例的实际解决方案都是公开的。 每个 shell 命令在 10 分钟后将超时。 所有设置均使用相同的两个模型和相同的预算：每次运行将在达到 100 步、30 分钟或 4 美元（以先到者为准）时停止，费用则从实际账单中扣除。

paragraphs.en: We compare BBCFixer with two settings. (1) The Pure Agent setting, which shows what the agent repairs on its own, without added instructions. In this setting, the agent receives only the broken downstream repository and its error message. The agent can inspect the repository and the installed library but receives no upgrade evidence. (2) The BDUpdater setting, which replicates the method design of the original tool ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , adapted to BBCBench by mounting the released sources of both library versions and the upstream repository instead of network lookups and by dropping its dependency-bump step. In this setting, the agent itself mines changelogs, release notes, and commit messages into a list of breaking changes, verifies each entry against the source, and adapts the affected call sites.

paragraphs.en: Each setting repeats the full benchmark three times, because the outcome of a single run varies between repetitions of the same case. A round is one repetition over all 100 cases, and a run is one case in one round, so each setting produces 300 runs per model. The primary metric is the average pass rate over the three rounds, and the cases passing in all three runs, in the best round, in at least two runs, and in any run (pass@3) give robustness views. We test each difference between two settings at the case level and treat the three runs of a case as one unit. A paired bootstrap over the 100 cases gives the 95% confidence interval of the pass-rate difference in percentage points, a Wilcoxon signed-rank test compares the per-case pass counts, and an exact McNemar test compares the cases that only one setting repairs in all three runs. The result tables report these two McNemar counts as the A only and B only columns. Within each model, the p p -values of each result table are Holm-corrected over its two comparisons of BBCFixer.

paragraphs.en: We answer four research questions to evaluate our approach:
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过回答四个研究问题来评估我们的方法：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Pure Agent Behavior and Failure Patterns): What upstream information do LLM-based agents consult when they repair a behavioral breaking change under the Pure Agent setting, and what failure patterns do their trajectories present?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1（纯智能体行为与失败模式）：在“纯智能体”设定下，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体在修复行为层面的破坏性变更时，会参考哪些上游信息？其执行轨迹又会呈现出哪些失败模式？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (Effectiveness of BBCFixer): To what extent does BBCFixer improve the repair performance of agents on behavioral breaking changes compared with two baselines (i.e., Pure Agent and BDUpdater), and at what cost in agent effort?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2（BBCFixer 的有效性）：与两种基线方法（即 Pure Agent 和 BDUpdater）相比，BBCFixer 在修复行为破坏性变更方面能多大程度提升智能体的修复性能？同时，这种提升需要付出多大的智能体努力成本？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (Effect of Different Evidence Configurations): How does the repair performance of BBCFixer change when the library diff is filtered without the first divergence, or when the first divergence is supplied without the library diff?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题3（不同证据配置的影响）：当在过滤库差异时不包含首次分歧，或者在提供首次分歧时不包含库差异时，BBCFixer 的修复性能会发生怎样的变化？

paragraphs.en: RQ4 (Root-API Identification and Repair Outcomes): How often does each setting identify the root API (RQ4.1), does identifying it predict a successful repair (RQ4.2), and does the gain of BBCFixer concentrate on the cases whose evidence points to the labeled root API (RQ4.3)?
paragraphs.zh: RQ4（根API识别与修复结果）：每种设置有多频繁地能够识别出根API（RQ4.1）？识别出根API能否预测修复成功（RQ4.2）？BBCFixer的性能提升是否主要集中在那些证据指向已标注根API的案例中（RQ4.3）？

paragraphs.en: RQ1 examines how the agent behaves under the Pure Agent setting (Section 3.3 ), in which it repairs a behavioral break without upgrade-specific evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1（RQ1）旨在探究智能体在“纯智能体”设定（第3.3节）下的行为表现，在此设定中，智能体无需依赖特定升级证据即可修复行为中断。

paragraphs.en: We classify the shell commands of all 300 trajectories per model with a fixed rule, which counts only the commands that read materials of the upgraded library, and record two types of consulted information: textual information (README, changelog, and migration guides) and code-level information (the installed upstream source and its tests). On a random sample of 100 trajectories, the rule agrees with the manual labels on an average of 87.0% of them (Cohen’s kappa 0.83). Table 3 reports the distribution.

paragraphs.en: To answer this RQ, we compare the repair performance of BBCFixer with that of Pure Agent and BDUpdater ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , test the differences for significance, and compare the agent effort that each setting spends per successful repair.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 compares the repair outcomes of the three settings. BBCFixer outperforms Pure Agent under every view with both models, raising the average pass rate by 17% with qwen3-coder and by 12% with GLM-4.5-Air. The size of the gain follows the strictness of the view. Under the strictest view, the cases that pass in all three runs, the gain grows to 27% and 33%. These results show that BBCFixer improves repair robustness at scale: its advantage lies not primarily in reaching cases that Pure Agent never repairs, but in repairing the same cases consistently across repeated runs. Under both models, BBCFixer also passes more cases than both Pure Agent and BDUpdater in each of the three rounds, further demonstrating the consistency of its improvement rather than an average driven by a single strong round.

paragraphs.en: BDUpdater never exceeds BBCFixer in average pass rate. With qwen3-coder it stays below even Pure Agent under every view, and with GLM-4.5-Air it stays close to Pure Agent and passes BBCFixer only under pass@3. BDUpdater repairs many cases in at least one run but few of them in all three, which makes it the least stable of the three settings. A reading of the 54 failing runs of this setting in the first round under qwen3-coder shows two causes, and neither is missing documentation. About half of the runs spend most of the shared budget on mining and end with no repair action or with edits only in the final steps. About a third of the runs see the text that documents the root API yet edit the wrong file or apply a wrong fix, because documentation records what changes in the library, not how the downstream code must change.
paragraphs.zh: BDUpdater 的平均通过率从未超过 BBCFixer。 使用 qwen3-coder 时，它在所有视图下都低于 Pure Agent；而使用 GLM-4.5-Air 时，它与 Pure Agent 的表现接近，且仅在 pass@3 的情况下通过 BBCFixer。 BDUpdater 能在至少一次运行中修复许多问题，但很少能在三次运行中全部修复，这使其成为三种设置中最不稳定的一个。 在 qwen3-coder 下第一轮测试中，该设置出现了 54 次失败运行，分析这些运行可以发现两个原因，而这两个原因都与文档缺失无关。 大约一半的运行将共享预算的大部分用于挖掘，最终没有执行任何修复操作，或仅在最后几步中进行修改。 大约三分之一的运行虽然看到了记录根 API 的文本，却修改了错误的文件或应用了错误的修复方案，因为文档记录的是库中的哪些发生了变化，而非下游代码必须如何更改。

paragraphs.en: The case hubot-coffeepoll in Figure 1 shows how the evidence obtained by BBCFixer changes a run. paragraphs.en: We next examine whether the gain of BBCFixer concentrates on the cases whose evidence points to the labeled root API. The evidence points to the labeled root API when either the first divergence or the filtered library diff identifies that API. We label each case for this property (Section 3.3 ) from the calls recorded in the two runs. paragraphs.en: Among the runs that never identify the root API, BBCFixer still has the highest pass rate under both models (RQ4.2). paragraphs.en: The outcome of a single run varies between repetitions of the same setting, so every number in the paper is a three-round average. paragraphs.en: BBCBench contains 41 Python and 59 JavaScript cases, and the evaluation uses one agent framework and two open models, so results by library, language, or model rest on small samples. We choose open, low-priced models because realistic deployment repairs many projects at every upgrade (Section 1 ). The gains of BBCFixer are therefore not measured on higher-priced proprietary models. Differential execution records only the calls that enter the library from outside it, so when it reports no divergence, the filtered library diff carries the diagnosis alone. That filtered library diff states the new expected value only when the library revises its own tests, which Mostafa et al. find for 90.2% of the behavioral backward incompatibilities they detect ( Mostafa et al., 2017 ) . This share is an upper bound for our setting, because those incompatibilities are found by running the library tests themselves, which cover them by construction. Some reference fixes come from public repositories and may have appeared in model training data, although agents cannot access online resources during repair and never see the reference fix. Future work should evaluate on temporally held-out upgrades and newly collected cases.
paragraphs.zh: BBCBench 包含 41 个 Python 案例和 59 个 JavaScript 案例，其评估使用一个智能体框架和两个开放模型，因此按库、语言或模型分类的结果仅基于小样本。 我们选择开放且价格较低的模型，因为真实的部署会在每次升级时修复许多项目（第 1 节）。 因此，BBCFixer 的改进并未在价格更高的专有模型上进行衡量。 差异执行仅记录从外部传入库的调用，因此当它报告没有分歧时，过滤后的库差异便单独承载了诊断信息。 该过滤后的库差异仅在库修改自身测试时才会声明新的预期值，而 Mostafa 等人发现，在他们检测到的行为向后不兼容问题中，有 90.2% 属于这种情况（Mostafa et al., 2017）。 这一比例是我们设定情况的一个上限，因为这些不兼容性问题是通过运行库自身的测试发现的，而这些测试按设计就涵盖了这些问题。 部分参考修复来自公开仓库，可能已出现在模型训练数据中，尽管智能体在修复过程中无法访问在线资源，也从未见过参考修复方案。 未来的工作应在时间上预留的升级版本和新收集的案例中进行评估。

sents.en: Differential execution records only the calls that enter the library from outside it, so when it reports no divergence, the filtered library diff carries the diagnosis alone.
sents.zh: 差异执行仅记录从外部传入库的调用，因此当它报告没有分歧时，过滤后的库差异便单独承载了诊断信息。

sents.en: That filtered library diff states the new expected value only when the library revises its own tests, which Mostafa et al. find for 90.2% of the behavioral backward incompatibilities they detect ( Mostafa et al., 2017 ) .
sents.zh: 该过滤后的库差异仅在库修改自身测试时才会声明新的预期值，而 Mostafa 等人发现，在他们检测到的行为向后不兼容问题中，有 90.2% 属于这种情况（Mostafa et al., 2017）。

sents.en: This share is an upper bound for our setting, because those incompatibilities are found by running the library tests themselves, which cover them by construction.
sents.zh: 这一比例是我们设定情况的一个上限，因为这些不兼容性问题是通过运行库自身的测试发现的，而这些测试按设计就涵盖了这些问题。

sents.en: Some reference fixes come from public repositories and may have appeared in model training data, although agents cannot access online resources during repair and never see the reference fix.
sents.zh: 部分参考修复来自公开仓库，可能已出现在模型训练数据中，尽管智能体在修复过程中无法访问在线资源，也从未见过参考修复方案。

sents.en: Future work should evaluate on temporally held-out upgrades and newly collected cases.
sents.zh: 未来的工作应在时间上预留的升级版本和新收集的案例中进行评估。

paragraphs.en: This work builds on two areas of prior research, empirical studies and detection tools for behavioral breaking changes (Section 7.1 ), and methods that repair breaking changes (Section 7.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作基于两个领域的先前研究：行为破坏性变更的经验性研究和检测工具（第 7.1 节），以及修复破坏性变更的方法（第 7.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Empirical studies measure how often behavioral breaking changes occur and how they reach the downstream project. Mostafa et al. inspect 126 behavioral backward incompatibilities in 15 Java libraries ( Mostafa et al., 2017 ) . Kong et al. find that behavior changes are the largest category of breaking changes marked by npm maintainers, at 68.1% ( Kong et al., 2025 ) . Jayasuriya et al. find that behavioral breaking changes reach client test suites as exceptions or assertion failures ( Jayasuriya et al., 2024 ) . Montandon et al. find that changed default argument values in Scikit-Learn affect 35% of the clients they analyze ( Montandon et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 实证研究测量了行为破坏性变更的发生频率，以及这些变更如何影响下游项目。 Mostafa 等人检查了 15 个 Java 库中的 126 种行为向后不兼容问题（Mostafa 等人，2017）。 Kong 等人发现，行为变更是 npm 维护者标记的破坏性变更中最大的类别，占比为 68.1%（Kong 等人，2025）。 Jayasuriya 等人发现，行为破坏性变更以异常或断言失败的形式影响客户端测试套件（Jayasuriya 等人，2024）。 Montandon 等人发现，Scikit-Learn 中默认参数值的变更影响了他们所分析的 35% 的客户端（Montandon 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Detection tools report the changed APIs. Static tools compare the two library versions without executing them. Sembid compares the semantic graphs of APIs whose signatures are unchanged and, as its authors report, misses changes that are only triggered dynamically ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) , UnCheckGuard lists the unchecked exceptions that a new version adds ( Sharma and Lam, 2025 ) , and Uppdatera reports the changed functions that the client reaches in a static call graph ( Hejderup and Gousios, 2022 ) . Dynamic tools execute code to observe the change. DeBBI runs the test suites of client projects against the new version ( Chen et al., 2020 ) , and GILESI, the closest to differential execution, records the inputs and outputs of every library call during client test execution and compares them across versions ( Monce et al., 2025 ) . SENSOR and CompCheck generate tests that reveal semantic differences between two library versions ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ) , and Testora does the same for the two sides of one pull request ( Pradel, 2026 ) . All of these tools stop at detection, whereas BBCFixer filters the library diff with the first divergence and gives both items to the repair agent.
paragraphs.zh: 检测工具报告发生变化的 API。 静态工具在不执行代码的情况下比较两个库版本。 Sembid 比较签名未变的 API 的语义图，但正如其作者所报告的，它会遗漏仅由动态触发の変更（Zhang et al., 2022）；UnCheckGuard 列出新版本增加的未检查异常（Sharma and Lam, 2025）；而 Uppdatera 则报告客户端在静态调用图中访问到的已变更函数（Hejderup and Gousios, 2022）。 动态工具通过执行代码来观察变化。 DeBBI 将客户端项目的测试套件在新版本上运行（Chen et al., 2020）；而最接近差异执行方法的 GILESI，则记录客户端测试执行期间每个库调用的输入和输出，并在不同版本间进行比较（Monce et al., 2025）。 SENSOR 和 CompCheck 生成能够揭示两个库版本之间语义差异的测试（Wang et al., 2022；Zhu et al., 2023）；Testora 则对单个拉取请求的两边执行同样的操作（Pradel, 2026）。 所有这些工具都止步于检测阶段，而 BBCFixer 会在首次出现差异时过滤库的差分，并将两个项目一并提供给修复智能体。

paragraphs.en: Before LLMs, repair methods apply transformation rules from different sources. SemDiff recommends the adaptation that the framework makes to its own code ( Dagenais and Robillard, 2008 ) , APIfix synthesizes rules from adaptations of other clients ( Gao et al., 2021 ) , MELT mines rules from merged library pull requests ( Ramos et al., 2024 ) , and JSFIX applies semantic patches written for the change ( Nielsen et al., 2021 ) . All four need an existing adaptation or a written description, and a behavioral change that no one has adapted or described gives neither.
paragraphs.zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）出现之前，修复方法会应用来自不同来源的转换规则。 SemDiff 推荐框架对其自身代码所做的适配（Dagenais 和 Robillard，2008），APIfix 从其他客户端的适配中合成规则（Gao 等人，2021），MELT 从合并后的库拉取请求中挖掘规则（Ramos 等人，2024），而 JSFIX 则应用为此次变更编写的语义补丁（Nielsen 等人，2021）。 这四种方法都需要一个现有的适配或书面描述；如果存在无人适配或描述过的行为变更，它们便都无法发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based methods form three lines by their source of evidence. The first line starts from the compile error of the broken build. Byam rewrites each failing file in one LLM call with the interface diff of the upgrade in the prompt ( Reyes et al., 2026b ) , Fruntke and Krinke let an agent read the repository and revise patches on build feedback ( Fruntke and Krinke, 2025 ) , BigBag generates a reusable AST transformation program ( Reyes et al., 2026a ) , and DependaFix packages Byam as a GitHub App ( Mecheo et al., 2026 ) . All four handle only updates that fail at compilation, and Byam reports that semantic failures appear once compilation is restored. The second line repairs from what the maintainers of the library write. Tawosi et al. drive a multi-agent framework with migration documentation ( Tawosi et al., 2025 ) , BDUpdater, which we replicate in our evaluation, mines breaking change records from the upstream repository ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , and DepRepair distills release notes into a rule table ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . The third line reads the library diff. AIMigrate prompts the LLM once per project file with the diff between the two library versions ( Rosenfeld et al., 2025 ) . The tool does not run the project, so the diff is neither cut down to the break nor checked against it. Benchmarks accompany these methods. Section 3.2 evaluates BUMP ( Reyes et al., 2024 ) , CompSuite ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , TimeMachine-bench ( Fujii et al., 2026 ) , and RepoRescue ( Lin et al., 2026 ) against the requirements of the repair task. MigrationBench ( Liu et al., 2026b ) and FreshBrew ( May et al., 2025 ) target migration away from Java 8, and GitChameleon 2.0 poses version-conditioned Python completion problems ( Misra et al., 2025 ) , so all three test whether the model writes code for a given version, not whether it repairs a broken downstream project. In sum, prior methods start from a compile error, a written description, or an unfiltered library diff, whereas BBCFixer starts from the behavior change observed by running the failing test under both versions.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的方法根据证据来源分为三类。 第一类方法从构建失败所引发的编译错误入手。 Byam 通过一次 LLM 调用重写每个出错的文件，并在提示词中嵌入升级的接口差异（Reyes et al., 2026b）；Fruntke 和 Krinke 让智能体读取代码库并根据构建反馈修改补丁（Fruntke and Krinke, 2025）；BigBag 生成一个可重用的 AST 转换程序（Reyes et al., 2026a）；而 DependaFix 则将 Byam 封装为一个 GitHub App（Mecheo et al., 2026）。 这四种方法都仅处理在编译阶段失败的更新，且 Byam 报告称，一旦编译问题得到解决，语义错误便会显现。 第二类方法则依据库的维护者所撰写的说明进行修复。 Tawosi 等人通过迁移文档驱动一个多智能体框架（Tawosi et al., 2025）；BDUpdater 从上游代码库中挖掘破坏性变更记录（Xia et al., 2026），我们在评估中也复现了该方法；而 DepRepair 则将发布说明提炼成一张规则表（Yang et al., 2026）。 第三类方法则读取库的变更差异。 AIMigrate 为每个项目文件单独向 LLM 发送一次提示，其中包含两个库版本之间的差异（Rosenfeld et al., 2025）。 该工具不会运行项目，因此差异既未被裁剪至引发问题的部分，也未经过实际验证。 这些方法均配有基准测试。 第 3.2 节评估了 BUMP（Reyes et al., 2024）、CompSuite（Xu et al., 2024）、TimeMachine-bench（Fujii et al., 2026）和 RepoRescue（Lin et al., 2026）在修复任务需求方面的表现。 MigrationBench（Liu et al., 2026b）和 FreshBrew（May et al., 2025）专注于从 Java 8 迁移的场景，而 GitChameleon 2.0 则提出基于版本条件的 Python 代码补全问题（Misra et al., 2025）；因此，这三种方法均测试模型能否为指定版本编写代码，而非能否修复下游的故障项目。 总而言之，以往的方法都从编译错误、书面说明或未过滤的库差异入手，而 BBCFixer 则是从在两个版本下运行失败测试时观察到的行为变化出发。

paragraphs.en: This paper finds that existing LLM-based repair methods and Pure Agent often fail to obtain the upstream evidence that a successful and efficient repair of a behavioral breaking change requires. Based on this finding, we propose BBCFixer, a repair method that runs the failing test under the old and new library versions, ranks the calls whose return value differs to identify a candidate root API, and filters the library diff with that candidate. The paper also contributes BBCBench, a benchmark of 100 behavioral dependency breaks in Python and JavaScript. On BBCBench, BBCFixer raises the average pass rate by up to 17% relative to Pure Agent and needs up to 27% fewer agent steps per successful repair. These results show that BBCFixer repairs behavioral breaking changes more effectively and efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 本文发现，现有的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的修复方法以及 Pure Agent 常常无法获取成功且高效地修复行为破坏性变更所需的上游证据。 基于这一发现，我们提出了 BBCFixer——一种修复方法：它在旧版和新版库版本下运行失败的测试，对返回值不同的调用进行排序以识别候选根 API，并据此筛选库的差异。 本文还贡献了 BBCBench，一个包含 100 个 Python 和 JavaScript 行为依赖破坏案例的基准测试集。 在 BBCBench 上，BBCFixer 的平均通过率相比 Pure Agent 最高提升了 17%，且每次成功修复所需的智能体步骤最多减少了 27%。 这些结果表明，BBCFixer 能够更有效、更高效地修复行为破坏性变更。

sents.en: On BBCBench, BBCFixer raises the average pass rate by up to 17% relative to Pure Agent and needs up to 27% fewer agent steps per successful repair.
sents.zh: 在 BBCBench 上，BBCFixer 的平均通过率相比 Pure Agent 最高提升了 17%，且每次成功修复所需的智能体步骤最多减少了 27%。

sents.en: These results show that BBCFixer repairs behavioral breaking changes more effectively and efficiently.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，BBCFixer 能够更有效、更高效地修复行为破坏性变更。

paragraphs.en: The replication package contains the implementation of BBCFixer and BBCBench, so the results can be reproduced directly. The package is available at https://github.com/Elendil3703/BBCFixer .
paragraphs.zh: 该复现包包含了 BBCFixer 和 BBCBench 的实现，因此可以直接复现结果。 该包可在 https://github.com/Elendil3703/BBCFixer 获取。
